name: FusionRS
description: Remote sensing vision-language models have advanced Earth observation, but available large-scale vision-language resources remain RGB-centered, leaving complementary infrared information underexplored. Infrared observations provide distinctive intensity structures, object boundaries, and illumination-invariant cues that complement conventional RGB imagery, yet large-scale RGB-infrared-text resources remain scarce. We introduce FusionRS, the first large-scale RGB-infrared-style-text dataset for controlled dual-modal remote sensing vision-language learning.
